items.title: Blackstone-backed Horizontal Industrial Parks IPO a long-term bet: Analysts
items.description: Horizon Industrial Parks IPO price band is fixed at ₹57 to ₹60 per share. The lot size for an application is 250 shares.

items.title: Solid debut! Molbio Diagnostics shares list at 21% premium over IPO price
items.description: The listing beat expectations as signalled by the grey market premium (GMP). Ahead of its debut today, Molbio Diagnostics IPO GMP was ₹120, suggesting 15 per cent listing pop.
